Cross-validate conditional references with child-level or site-level folds

Source: R/quant-condref.R
wgh_condref_cv.Rd

Splits children into folds (or leaves one site out at a time), fits wgh_condref() on the training part and scores the conditional model and the benchmarks on the held-out part with wgh_score().

Usage

wgh_condref_cv(
  panel,
  folds = 5,
  formula = ~baseline_haz + baseline_baz + baseline_age,
  taus = wgh_taus(c(0.03, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95, 0.97)),
  seed = 2026,
  forest = FALSE
)

Arguments

panel

Output of wgh_conditional_panel().

folds

Number of child-level folds, or "site" for leave-one-site-out.

formula, taus

Passed to wgh_condref().

seed

Random seed.

forest

Also score a quantile random forest (model = "forest", needs ranger).

Value

A tibble of scores by fold, model, sex and target age. Lower CRPS and WIS are better, and coverage_90 should be close to 0.90.

Examples

# \donttest{
cp <- wgh_conditional_panel(growdat, targets = c(10, 12))
cv <- wgh_condref_cv(cp, folds = 3)
aggregate(cbind(crps, wis, coverage_90) ~ model, data = cv, FUN = mean)
#>           model      crps       wis coverage_90
#> 1   conditional 0.2187820 0.1839192   0.8551945
#> 2   persistence 0.2365102 0.1979202   0.8888827
#> 3 unconditional 0.4111011 0.3462663   0.8851147
#> 4           who 0.5608287 0.4677966   0.9008800
# }
